title: Microsoft Teams: Choose Your Enter Key Behavior in Teams Chat
description: Microsoft Teams now gives you control over how the Enter key works when composing messages. You can choose whether pressing Enter sends your message or starts a new line—making it easier to write longer messages without accidental sends.
